features.cite: Zertal 2005 (Eng. Vol. 4) Site 45, p. 200 (quoting Conder and Kitchener 1882: 246)
features.quote: An artificial mound, now occupied by an Arab graveyard.

date.basis: Arab (Muslim) graveyard in use in the 19th c.; securely after 135 CE

notes: The survey team could not visit the site (minefield) and observed it from about 200 m W. The only pool, pit or grave is the Arab graveyard on the mound, which the entry quotes from the British Survey; it is placed on the site itself, with no direction. 'Cisterns: not known' is not an absence statement. Glueck's small Roman-Byzantine ruin to the N-W has no pool, pit or grave. No plan.
